newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose 33.48 points to 6,600.66. PLDT's ADR fell $0.25 to $51 5/8.
* On Tuesday, the peso weakened to 26.304 to a U.S. dollar from 26.287.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,195.47, up 9.10.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was down at 10.5625 pct from 10.8125 pct.
* BusinessWorld says the Philippines may delay its exit from the International Monetary Fund if the tax reform and and the oil deregulation programmes are not completed by June this year.
* Petron awards a 3.0-billion peso contract to Daelim Engineering of South Korea and Mitsui Co Ltd of Japan to build support infrastructure in its Bataan refinery.
* Philippines' gross international reserves hit an all-time high of $12.308 billion last Monday, the Central Bank says.
* Philippine Daily Inquirer says Tokai Bank of Japan will buy 30 percent of Global Bank, the new commercial bank of Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co.
* Philippine Daily Inquirer says Filinvest Develoment Corp has created a new corporation, Filinvest Asia Corp, which will engage in developing and leasing of commercial and residential buildings.
* Angping Securities recommends a hold on both Philipping Long Distance Telephone Co and Vitarich Corp.
* Philippine Asia Equity recommends a buy for Mondragon International Philippines Inc and a hold on International Container Terminal Services inc.
